description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View called DebugSettings, which provides a user interface for diagnosing and debugging various aspects of an OpenClaw application. It includes sections for app info, gateway status, logs, port diagnostics, path configurations, quick actions, Canvas interactions, and experimental features. The file manages internal state, performs async actions such as reloading models, checking ports, resetting tunnels, and evaluating JavaScript in Canvas. It also references several external modules for handling system actions, configurations, and process management.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: A custom SwiftUI GroupBoxStyle for styling the settings sections with a vertical stack and captioned labels.

methods.name: runPortCheck
methods.description: Asynchronously performs a network port check for gateway ports and updates the portReports state.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the SSH tunnel for the gateway and updates related status fields.

methods.name: requestKill
methods.description: Handles user request to kill a process listening on a port, prompts for confirmation if expected, or kills immediately.

methods.name: killConfirmed
methods.description: Executes the process kill asynchronously and updates the UI with the result.

methods.name: chooseCatalogFile
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a models.generated.ts file, updating the model catalog path and reloading models.

methods.name: reloadModels
methods.description: Loads the model catalog asynchronously, updating the models count and error state.

methods.name: sendVoiceDebug
methods.description: Sends a debug voice message asynchronously, updating status and error states.

methods.name: revealApp
methods.description: Reveals the app bundle in Finder.

methods.name: saveRelayRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path in the GatewayProcessManager.

methods.name: loadSessionStorePath
methods.description: Loads session store path from configuration.

methods.name: saveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Saves the current session store path into configuration.

methods.name: canvasPresent
methods.description: Shows a Canvas session panel with the specified session key.

methods.name: canvasWriteSamplePage
methods.description: Writes a sample HTML page to the Canvas session directory.

methods.name: canvasEval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the Canvas session and updates the result.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current Canvas session.
